# Daily Repository Status Report — Vinheria Digital

You are a maintainer assistant for the **Vinheria Digital** microservices monorepo — a B2B wine distribution platform built with Quarkus + Kotlin (backend) and Angular (frontend). Your task is to generate a **daily health report** and publish it as a GitHub issue.

## Step 1 — Load Previous State

Read `daily-report-state.json` from cache-memory. If absent, initialize with:

```json
{
  "last_run_date": null,
  "previous_open_issues": 0,
  "previous_open_prs": 0,
  "previous_ci_failures": 0
}
```

If `last_run_date` equals today's date (YYYY-MM-DD), skip creating a new issue and exit — the report was already generated today.

## Step 2 — Gather Repository Data

Use the GitHub MCP tools to collect the following. All searches are scoped to this repository.

### Issues
- Total **open issues** count, broken down by label (bug, enhancement, etc.)
- Issues **opened in the last 24 hours** (title, author, URL)
- Issues **closed in the last 24 hours** (title, who closed it, URL)
- Issues with no activity for **more than 14 days** (potential stale — list up to 5)
- Any issues labeled `critical`, `high-priority`, or `security`

### Pull Requests
- Total **open PRs** count
- PRs **opened in the last 24 hours** (title, author, URL)
- PRs **merged in the last 24 hours** (title, merger, URL) — credit the human who reviewed/merged
- PRs **open for more than 3 days without a review** (stale PRs — list up to 5)
- Any open PRs with **failing checks**

### CI / CD Pipeline
- Latest run status of the **CI Pipeline** workflow on `main`
- Latest run status of the **Security** workflow on `main`
- Any workflow runs that **failed in the last 24 hours** (workflow name, run URL)

### Recent Activity
- The last **5 commits on `main`** (short SHA, author, message, relative timestamp)

## Step 3 — Compute Trends

Compare current counts to the previous state loaded in Step 1:
- Open issues: ▲ if increased, ▼ if decreased, → if unchanged
- Open PRs: same comparison
- CI failures: flag "new failures" if count is higher than yesterday

## Step 4 — Create Report Issue

Create a GitHub issue with the report. Use this exact format:

**Title**: `📊 Daily Status Report — YYYY-MM-DD`

**Body**:

```markdown
## 📊 Daily Repository Status — {full weekday, Month DD YYYY}

> Auto-generated by the [Daily Status Report](.github/workflows/daily-repo-status.md) workflow.

---

### 🐛 Issues

| Metric | Count | Trend |
|--------|------:|-------|
| Open issues | N | 📈/📉/➡️ |
| Opened today | N | — |
| Closed today | N | — |
| Stale (>14 days, no activity) | N | — |

**🔴 Critical / High-priority open issues:**
- (list with links, or _none_)

---

### 🔀 Pull Requests

| Metric | Count | Trend |
|--------|------:|-------|
| Open PRs | N | 📈/📉/➡️ |
| Opened today | N | — |
| Merged today | N | — |
| Awaiting review >3 days | N | — |

**⏳ Stale PRs needing review:**
- (list: title · author · age, or _none_)

**✅ Merged today:**
- (list: title · merged by, or _none_)

---

### 🏗️ CI / CD

| Workflow | Latest Run | Branch |
|----------|:----------:|--------|
| CI Pipeline | ✅ Passing / ❌ Failed | main |
| Security Scan | ✅ Passing / ❌ Failed | main |

**❌ Failures in last 24 h:** (list with run links, or _none_)

---

### 📝 Recent Commits on `main`

| SHA | Author | Message | When |
|-----|--------|---------|------|
| `abc1234` | @user | feat(sales): ... | 2 h ago |
| ... | | | |

---

### ✅ Action Items

Summarize what needs human attention today. Be specific:

- [ ] (e.g., PR #42 has been waiting review for 5 days — @reviewer please check)
- [ ] (e.g., CI failed on run #123 — investigate test flakiness in `vinheria-sales`)
- [ ] (e.g., Issue #17 labeled `critical` is unassigned)

_If everything looks healthy, state that explicitly._
```

**Attribution rule**: When a commit or PR was authored or merged by `@github-actions[bot]` or `@Copilot`, identify the human who triggered, reviewed, or approved it and credit them instead.

## Step 5 — Update Cache Memory

Save current state to `daily-report-state.json` in cache-memory before finishing:

```json
{
  "last_run_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "previous_open_issues": <count>,
  "previous_open_prs": <count>,
  "previous_ci_failures": <count_of_failures_in_last_24h>
}
```

Use filesystem-safe timestamp format `YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS` (no colons, no `T`, no `Z`) for any timestamped artifact files.
